verified: Google’s Play Console help page says every active developer account must declare whether it is a “trader” or “non-trader” under EEA and UK law by February 1, 2027, regardless of where its apps are distributed; The Verge reported that Google announced the change to comply with the EU Digital Services Act and that contact details will be made public worldwide.
unconfirmed: Which developers will be classified as traders and exactly which phone number and address will be published; Google’s revenue-based guidance is broad, the report is truncated, and no independent confirmation or implementation details are available.

verified: Google Play 官方帮助页面写明，所有有效开发者账号都必须在 2027 年 2 月 1 日前声明自己是“商户”（trader）还是非商户，无论应用面向哪个地区发布；The Verge 报道称，被认定为商户的开发者需公开电话号码和地址，且这些信息全球可见。
unconfirmed: The Verge 的报道摘要不完整，因此“商户”的具体判定标准（Google 仅笼统描述为从应用中获取收入、尤其收入规律或量大者）、非商户的豁免范围、页面上究竟展示哪些字段、个人开发者是否会因此暴露住址，以及逾期不申报的具体后果，都尚未得到完整核实。

titles.en: Google to Require Public Contact Details From Many Android Developers
titles.zh: Google将要求许多Android开发者公开电话和地址
